newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND SHOULD BE ABLE TO FIELD FULL-STRENGTH SIDE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND SHOULD BE ABLE TO FIELD FULL-STRENGTH SIDE.

text.p: England should be able to field their first choice team against France in the Five Nations' championship at Twickenham on Saturday.
Six of the home squad have been suffering from niggling injuries with open-side flanker Richard Hill the worst affected with an ankle sprain.
Neil Back, open-side flanker in the England A side, joined the team at training on Thursday but Hill is expected to be fit for Saturday.
Gate receipts on Saturday will exceed two million pounds sterling ($3.3 million), bringing the season's total for rugby union's world headquarters to a record 15 million pounds ($24 million).
Wales' fly-half Arwel Thomas, who strained knee ligaments in a club match last Saturday, may miss his country's final round match against England at Cardiff Arms Park on March 15.
Thomas joins wing Ieuan Evans and prop Christian Loader on the injury list.
